authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7150 nikta, replaced by *nikka in Middle Indo-Aryan, explicitly gives Punjabi nikkā small and Maithili nikāh good. These small/good responses fit that documented semantic range. Exact survey form nikːa is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
